**Allowed origins:** `http://localhost:4200` (exact match), any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Where to add a new domain:** `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} })` function (lines ~20-28). Add another condition to the `if` block, e.g. `origin === 'https://your-domain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.your-domain.com')`, then return `origin`. Since Hono's CORS `origin` only matches array entries as exact strings, wildcard domains must go in this function, not in an array. See `worker/src/index.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md#4-cors` for background.
